t: State and Local Government Affairs Manager
content: We are looking for a strategic public policy professional to join Spotify’s Global Government Affairs team in New York City or Los Angeles. The Government Affairs team helps Spotify understand the global and local policy landscape, advocates on issues important to our business and users, and works to anticipate and mitigate policy and regulatory risks. In this role, you’ll work closely with Government Affairs colleagues and teams across Spotify to develop positions on public policy proposals and strategies to advance them. You’ll report to the Director of Government Affairs, US & Canada, with a particular focus on state and local policy.

The Music Mission team owns Spotify's end to end proposition for music creators and the experiences they create for fans. The team is dedicated to building tools and services to enable creation, promotion, expression, and monetization at scale. The Artist & Label Partnerships team (ALP) is the face of Spotify to artists, managers, labels and distributors across Sweden. We're looking for a Studio & Project Manager to make our Stockholm studio a place where artists, labels and fans connect, turning the stories behind artists and releases into sessions, video and formats that reach the next generation of listeners. You'll lead the studio and its projects with support from the wider ALP team, and project manage selected ALP initiatives so key partners see Spotify as their number one partner.
